text: I respectfully request your support for my motion to establish a drop-off and pick-up area on the north side Glebe Road East, to improve student access to The Study Academy’s Lower School. The Study Academy’s Lower School serves neurodivergent students between the ages of 8 and 13 years old. My office has heard from parents that students face accessibility and safety challenges during the morning and afternoon drop-off and pick-up periods, exacerbated by the proximity to Yonge Street and increased local congestion. A safe and accessible pick-up and drop-off zone is essential to ensure students can arrive at and leave school with greater ease and security. With the passage of this motion, the community will receive the parking reforms they have been organizing for.
